description:
Step R2 of fz-9zq. Buys: Enum.reduce([1,2], :start, fn x, acc -> {x, acc} end) compiles (no ticket before; develop hangs at 4,312 AA / 2,872 keys; probe: 115 AA, {2, {1, :start}}). The paper's call-site rule: per (callee, slot) widened pattern; a covered argument is keyed as the pattern; recursive callees only.
Also red under R1: Enum.reduce([1,2,3], [], fn x, acc -> [{x, acc} | acc] end) hangs on develop (7,758 AA) and under R1 (8,090 AA); same family (scratch mu2/r1/ord/reduce_cons_tuple.fz).

Research at e81f9ed52 (scratch 9zq_2/r/report.md):
- Refuted: the old probe's internal/unresolved-wait is not caused by re-keying the key without the evidence. Re-keying both gives 6 errors against 3 for key-only.
- A global per-(callee, slot) table merges unrelated callers' chains into one key. Scoping by the call's sibling columns (probe_R2s.diff) gives a clean distiller (+0.15%, md5 identical) and a green fixture_matrix, but it is a fragile proxy. It turns two lib tests red: the 00420 canon distinct-id count rises 142 -> 143, and 00548_contract_ast_eval collapses to eval/1[any]. It does not unhang t4b or bst, even with R4's probe.
- Carrying the evidence with the key lowers e177 ladders (AA 262 -> 236, max ascent 5 -> 1).
- H2 refuted (round 2): with the old fold criterion, all 42 stuck return-type keys have contributors (none zero), and only 4 of 49 stuck waits sit below a widened pattern.
- Fact-backed pattern (FactKey::CallPattern on the ContributionMap path, probe_Efact.diff): e177 and reduce_cons_tuple compile with correct output on all three paths. Not landable: distiller +21.5% (+11% chain-scoped), fixtures 00775/01006 stall, pins rise (group_conclusion, transport_contract, work_start_reason, public_trace, canon ids, distill derivations and reads). Old keys keep their stale AnalyzeActivation contributions.
- The 01006 stall is a satisfied wait that is never re-woken (f370 waits on f371's concluded return). Being located, including whether fz-t93.20/.21 cause it.
- 00548 collapses because the clash fold counts main's unrelated entry calls as a climb: a clash at ancestor_depth=0 on finite depth-3 terms. The candidate is the paper's same-principal-functor ancestor rule, untested.
- With the fz-t93.24 fix applied (scratch 9zq_2/t24/report.md), 01006 and 00775 pass. The +21.6% was the probe's CallPattern fact changing 704 times. Counting it as changed only when a widened column moves gives jobs equal to base and +2.7% (+1.4% chain-scoped); its soundness is unproven. Open: e177 needs a fold that 00548 forbids (chain scope and ancestor_depth>=1 fix 00548 but lose e177). The 00567 canon id count is 16 against a pin of 15, and distill reads +0.9..1.3%. A discriminator experiment is running (scratch 9zq_2/disc/).
- Discriminator found (scratch 9zq_2/disc/report.md, fix_Efact_V_S.diff). The call-pattern fold fires only when a covering ancestor has exactly the clashing node's principal functors (the paper's rule; R1's own folds unchanged). e177 folds at depth 0 with equal functors; 00548's node functors are a strict subset of the root's, so they never fold. Results: e177 and reduce_cons_tuple are correct on all three paths; the 00548 contract is green; 01006/00775 pass; fixture_matrix 3644/0; distiller +2.5%, md5 identical. Still red: the 00567 canon count (16 vs 15, no fold fires) and distill reads handed (+1.3%, inherent to a fact read per keying job). Untested: whether the fold is order-dependent across publishers (an experiment is running, scratch 9zq_2/ord/). t4b/bst still hang.
- Order test (scratch 9zq_2/ord/analysis.txt): the shared CallPattern candidate is order-dependent. On v2 (two Enum.reduce calls in one main, sharing reduce_cont/reduce_step) it gives 4 distinct plans in 12 orders, and 2 orders never settle. clash_fold relates successive values and is not associative, so publish order moves where the fold fires (confirmed with the local join removed: 6 states in 34 orders). Also hanging under the candidate: v1a ({x,acc} and {acc,x} reducers together); v3 (direct recursion building {n, acc}) hangs on base too. The 00567 extra id is CallPatternRow::join_assign unioning a closure slot that can never fold; it is avoidable. Next: widen against the call's own ancestor on its chain (no shared table; order-free by construction), with the engine fix and S (scratch 9zq_2/anc/).
title: A recursive callee's new call is widened against its previous call
